reviews.comment: Palmer is truly an amazing professor and a nice guy. Fair warning though, Assignment 3 WILL test your patience and determination for the class. Also, show up to the lectures. Both quizzes are randomly given during those times, they are based on attendance, and they are both worth 4% of your grade each.

Professor Palmer is great I loved the class. He is always more than happy to answer questions no matter how stupid or repetitive they are. Go to his office hours, ask questions, don't procrastinate, make friends, and record the labs and you'll get a good grade. Would 100% take the class again.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Great guy. Wants to help you. Seems disinterested at first, but he's great. Beware of assignment 3. Lock in for it. After that it's a breeze. The first quiz is attendance based and is RANDOMLY SCHEDULED. Show up to lectures for this reason at least.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: Blows through lectures, but it really wasn't that hard. Just take the time to understand the assignment and ASK QUESTIONS! Dude is such a nice guy, honestly. I also really enjoyed the class, and it was rewarding to me. Everyone likes to complain about the class, and although it is difficult, I mean, you are going to school for it, so just own it.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Palmer is a great professor for Estimating 1. Lectures can be brutal, and lab explanations are fast, but office hours are amazing. Go to him early if you're confused. Work in groups and show up to the lectures. TAKE NOTES. They are critical to doing well on the exams.

Challenging class, but Professor Palmer makes it worth it. Labs are very instructive, and he explains things clearly, you just have to pay attention. It's time-consuming, but he's understanding about technical issues or personal situations. Lectures are short, and he's fair and supportive throughout the course.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Respected

reviews.comment: Great professor. It's not difficult, just do your work diligently. If you actually put in the effort on assignments and pay attention to details this class is lightwork. He grades tough if you blow off his instructions, but all around learned a lot from this class.

Professor Palmer regularly blows through a 1h 15m lab in 20 minutes, and he explains nothing. He is an outrageous grader - on my second assignment, I received a 50 simply because I deleted a SINGLE negative sign, yet, my numbers were 100% accurate. In fact, he has inspired me to become an estimating professor because I know I would do a better job.

This class requires time, but it is not that bad.The main part of this class is the lab, where the assignments are given. Do not procrastinate and you will be fine. The concepts are easy, the assignments are just sometimes hard to understand. 

Go to office hours, Palmer is great, and I always left his office feeling confident about the assignment.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This was the hardest class I have taken at A&M.  Palmer was fine, but the assignments were so hard they took 12+ hours to complete.  I would not have survived without a study group and fellow Aggies who had taken it before reaching out to help.

I liked Palmer but he is not the best at explaining things. If you go into estimating with zero background info on construction it can be a tough adjustment (but not impossible). He really cares and is there when you need him so ask questions. Find a group to study with/ that is the most important part.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is truly the most difficult lower-level COSC class. Each assignment took around 8 to 14 hours to finish. They were also hard to figure out, but he was willing to clarify and explain. Working in groups is something to take into account for completing assignments. Exams are tricky, but the final should help boost your grade since it's open note.

I am not sure why these students have so many complaints about palmer. Drilled piers and grade beams are his hardest projects everything else is a cake walk. Pay attention in his lectures, go to his office hours, you will be fine. If you think Palmer is unbearable just wait till estimating two.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Not sure why all the hate for Palmer. Nice, quiet guy. If you are struggling just go talk to him. Start assignments early. Drilled piers is the weed out assignment, stay in it. If you think this is bad, Boldt will eat you like a tiger, RAWR.
shmuck

Not sure of the high praise. Amount of work assigned is incomprehensible. Pulling an all-nighter to finish one assignment is typical. Even people who time manage with perfection will struggle. He doesn't provide adequate explanations for his ever complex assignments. You will be questioning your life and your decisions up to this point.  Beware!

Not sure why Palmer has such good reviews lol. He literally doesn't teach you anything, he assigns you a ton of hw and expects you to do know how to do all of it after he goes over it one time extremly fast in lab. You really need a study group in this class to get through the hw and j the class in general, there is HOURS of homework everyweek.

Man this class kicks some butt and labs with Palmer don't feel entirely helpful however, Palmer is incredibly helpful and cares about his students. He loves what he teaches and makes sure that his students understand what they're learning. Do NOT be scared to ask questions because he's a very nice and approachable man. Find a study group and grind!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: For 275, class assignments are very important and, in my experience, where you will actually learn how to navigate plans for relevant information. Do not bear this class alone. Find a study group and talk to Mr. Palmer in his office hours. He always answered my questions so that I could understand the material, and he will do the same for anybody.

Very difficult class, and the projects take a very long time, but it helps that he is always willing to answer questions. I recommend finding a group of people to work with as it makes it a lot easier to get the projects done. But I'm glad that out of all the professors here he is the one to teach it.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Be sure to attend every class period. Pop quizzes during end of semester. Professor is a great guy but this class is difficult. Be sure to ask questions, he is very approachable.
incredible professor, hard class. Take your time and you will get through it

Palmer is very passionate about what he teaches and is always there to answer a question. Expect to have a good grasp of the estimating assignments because you will have to do some estimation on his exams. I also recommend starting the assignments a few days early as many of them will take several hours to complete.

Professor Palmer is one of the best professors I have had so far. The class is a very heavy workload, but he is always available to help. He is very understanding, and never makes you feel stupid if you don't grasp a topic. Don't be afraid to ask him 100 questions cause he will willing answer every one till you understand.

Prof. Palmer is very caring professor. He will teach you how to read plans and estimate from them effectively. As long as you put in adequate time, his class is an easy A. Do not hesitate to ask questions. Do not get behind on projects or leave them until last minute because you will have questions. Don't slack off.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This is a class that makes you work for your grade. Professor Palmer is a great guy that genuinely cares for his students and he wants to see you succeed. He's also really lenient when it comes to assignments. For instance, if you made a 50 on an assignment, he'll let you resubmit the assignment for the max grade of 80. Palmer is an OG, take him

Took Palmer for accelerated Estimating I. Class was fast paced but still very manageable. He was always accessible outside of class, be it in his office or him answering questions on Piazza. He tells you how to do the assignment but its up to you to get down in the details and really figure it out. Not a super easy A but easy enough if you work.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: If you're taking this class for accelerated, buckle up. Palmer is a cool guy but he gives instructions in labs as if you already know what he is talking about. Get a study group and you'll be good.

Professor Palmer is a great old school guy, he is always prepared for his lectures and labs. I strongly recommend that you get to know him as he is one of the smartest professors I've had. He makes himself very available to clarify topics & questions. Tests are straight forward.

Palmer is a good guy. straight forward and does mind slowing down or answering any questions at all! i would recommend taking him for sure, do well on all the assignments and the test wont even matter. he letes you work in teams so you wont be alone
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Professor Palmer is easily my favorite professor Ive ever had. Estimating is a hard class in general but if you work hard he is always willing to help you. He genuinely cares about his students and is an amazing person. Would absolutely recommend him.

This was an extremely difficult class, always has been and always will be. However, this man really knew his stuff and wants you to succeed. This class is major specific, so while it's a lot of homework you're learning something important. The professor will answer any questions you have 24 hours a day, and it's the most I've learned in any class.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures
